create.name: Neil Douglas-Klotz
create.bio:
Born in America and now living in Scotland, Neil Douglas-Klotz is a scholar, writer, musician and meditation teacher. His work concerns the spirituality of the native Middle East, and he translates from Hebrew, Aramaic and Arabic, above all the Aramaic words of Jesus. He has served as co-chair of the American Academy of Religion's Mysticism Group, directs the Edinburgh Institute for Advanced Learning, and in 1982 was a co-founder of the International Network for the Dances of Universal Peace. Under the name Saadi he is also a Sufi teacher in the lineage of Samuel L. Lewis.

Among his books are Revelations of the Aramaic Jesus, Original Meditation, Prayers of the Cosmos, The Hidden Gospel and The Aramaic Jesus Book of Days, as well as Desert Wisdom, The Little Book of Sufi Stories, The Sufi Book of Life, edited collections of Kahlil Gibran, and a novel. He teaches as much through chant, breath, meditation and sacred movement as through texts, leading online events and retreats through the Abwoon Network, and he has recorded four on-demand courses on the Aramaic Jesus for The Shift Network.

books.title: Prayers of the Cosmos: Meditations on the Aramaic Words of Jesus
books.author: Neil Douglas-Klotz
books.description: His first and best-known book, which offers expanded translations of the Lord's Prayer and the Beatitudes from Aramaic, the language Jesus spoke. Each line comes with a short body prayer or meditation, and the book carries a foreword by Matthew Fox.

books.title: The Hidden Gospel: Decoding the Spiritual Message of the Aramaic Jesus
books.author: Neil Douglas-Klotz
books.description: Reads key sayings of Jesus through the Aramaic language and the Middle Eastern worldview behind them, looking at words such as spirit, light, kingdom and holiness. Practices for breath and meditation accompany each chapter.

books.title: Revelations of the Aramaic Jesus: The Hidden Teachings on Life and Death
books.author: Neil Douglas-Klotz
books.description: Looks at what Jesus taught about life, death and what may follow, reading his sayings through the Aramaic language and the native Middle Eastern worldview. Matthew Fox wrote the foreword.

books.title: The Sufi Book of Life: 99 Pathways of the Heart for the Modern Dervish
books.author: Neil Douglas-Klotz
books.description: A guide to the ninety-nine Beautiful Names of Allah as pathways of the heart, with a reflection, story and practice for each. It can be read through or opened at random as a daily companion.

books.title: Desert Wisdom: A Nomad's Guide to Life's Big Questions from the Heart of the Native Middle East
books.author: Neil Douglas-Klotz
books.description: An anthology of sacred texts from the Middle Eastern traditions, from Sumerian and Egyptian writings to Hebrew, Christian and Sufi sources, in fresh translations arranged around life's big questions. Each section adds commentary and body-based practices.

books.title: Original Meditation: The Aramaic Jesus and the Spirituality of Creation
books.author: Neil Douglas-Klotz, Fatima Lassar
books.description: Explores the creation spirituality behind Jesus' teaching, read through the Aramaic and Hebrew of the opening of Genesis, with meditations drawn from the texts.

books.title: The Little Book of Sufi Stories: Ancient Wisdom to Nourish the Heart
books.author: Neil Douglas-Klotz, Maryam Mafi
books.description: A small collection of traditional Sufi teaching stories with an introduction on how such stories work on the listener. It is meant to be read slowly, a story at a time.

books.title: The Genesis Meditations: A Shared Practice of Peace for Christians, Jews, and Muslims
books.author: Neil Douglas-Klotz
books.description: Meditations on the shared roots of Judaism, Christianity and Islam in the opening of Genesis, written for people of different faiths to practise together. It works with the original-language words of the creation story.

courses.title: The Way of Aramaic Jesus
courses.description: A seven-session recorded course on the Lord's Prayer in Aramaic and the worldview behind it. Each session uses chant, silent meditation, breath and movement alongside the teaching.

courses.title: Advancing Along the Way of Aramaic Jesus
courses.description: An advanced recorded course on the Beatitudes in Matthew and Luke and on Holy Wisdom, taught through Aramaic words, chant, breath and meditation. It includes The Way of Aramaic Jesus.

courses.title: The Aramaic Jesus Within You
courses.description: A seven-session recorded course on the Gospels of John, Thomas, Mary Magdalene and Philip, including the 'I Am' sayings read in Aramaic. Teaching is paired with chant, story and body-based practice.

courses.title: The Final Heart Transmissions of the Aramaic Jesus
courses.description: A fourteen-session recorded course on the final teachings attributed to Jesus, read through Aramaic with chant, meditation and body practices. It continues and includes The Aramaic Jesus Within You.

free_resources.title: Abwoon Resource Library
free_resources.description: Neil's online archive of free articles, scholarly papers, video podcasts, recordings of practices and teachings, retreat handouts and dance and chant notation. Donations are welcome but not required.

free_resources.title: The Aramaic Jesus: Resources for Exploring Yeshua
free_resources.description: A free resource page with introductory videos, streamable audio and background on Neil's work with the Aramaic words of Jesus. It is a good starting point before the books or courses.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @AbwoonResourceCenter 2.81K subscribers (channel page, 30 Oct 2026); Facebook AuthorNeilDouglasKlotz 6,304 followers (og:description); auto-generated 'Neil Douglas-Klotz - Topic' music channel 3.48K not counted; no Instagram/X found → ~9k → local_hero
flags: Reputation clearly exceeds follower count: Prayers of the Cosmos (HarperOne, 1990) is a long-standing bestseller and his interviews reach 200k views, but his own accounts total under 10k.

No personal email is published; he says he has no staff and asks people to use the contact form. The same page gives resources@abwoon.org (a volunteer who finds resources in his work) and the store gives legacysales@abwoon.org (US CD sales); neither seemed right as a contact address.
Only one distinct photo exists across sources (the same 2017 portrait on abwoon.org, Shift and YouTube); both image URLs are that portrait.
The Way of Aramaic Jesus showed both $347 and $297 single-payment prices; $297 USD is taken as current (matching the sale pattern on his other Shift courses).
One interview title (Next Level Soul) is clickbait in capitals; kept because he is the main speaker, but a human may prefer to drop it.
Advancing Along the Way covers 'Yeshua's healings' as scripture; no medical claim, kept.
left_out: The Aramaic Jesus Book of Days (2025, ISBN 9781642970593) and Blessings of the Cosmos: amazon.com /dp/ pages returned errors, so ASINs couldn't be confirmed.
The Healing Breath (Sounds True audio): title borderline and an audio series, not a book.
Edited Kahlil Gibran collections, A Murder at Armageddon (novel), The Tent of Abraham and the biographies of his Sufi teachers: lesser known or not checked on Amazon; room kept for the main books.
Abwoon events: listed via a dynamic calendar I couldn't read; most are donation-based and dated.

Short clips under two minutes (the 51-second spoken Lord's Prayer), chant-only and dance-demonstration videos, music tracks on the auto-generated Topic channel, and The Shift Network's own livestream with him.
Upcoming Shift live course (January 2027): no page or title yet.
